Duplicate pending revision is rejected
Cross-client revision is rejected
Revision rejection requires reason
Client cannot review revision
Sales rejection and review history persist
Decided revision history is immutable
Revision approval preserves the existing quotation and revision
Requested quotation history cannot be reassigned
Owned cancellation request persists without cancelling transaction
Duplicate pending cancellation is rejected
Cross-client cancellation is rejected
Cancellation must begin pending
Blank request reason is rejected
Cancellation quotation must match inquiry
Inquiry ownership remains historical after request
Client-user ownership remains historical after request
Revision after PO is rejected
PO must reference an actual document
Renamed proof/file/document relationship round-trips through MySQL
Proof submitter must own invoice client
Proof submission/verification creates no confirmed payment automatically
Confirmed payment retains its composite FK to renamed proof
Confirmed downpayment blocks cancellation approval
Existing JO blocks cancellation approval
Request decision does not automatically cancel inquiry/quotation/PO
Decided cancellation history is immutable
Notification read flag requires timestamp
Per-user notification read state works with existing index/constraint
Existing audit events remain append only
All 42 pre-existing table record hashes/counts preserved after rollback
No request test fixtures retained
